Name: BatteryWarningMod
Author: Husky110
Description:
Another small mod by me.
I was pissed that my GPD Win always turned itself off while I was midgame, despite having Windows setup to notify me.
So this little mod came to live, which checks your remaining batterylife and gives you a warning when you hit 25%.
Why 25%? To give you enough time to end what you are doing and having a chance to end your day.
It will show the message only once!
So if you plug your device to the powergrid, you might wanna restart your game after you've finished your day.

Tested on Windows 10.
Might not work on Mac or Linux!

Source is maintained on [url=https://github.com/Husky110/BatteryWarningMod]GitHub[/url]
